description: Send the next (or given) dunning level for an invoice by e-mail and record it in the invoice's dunning history. Required: invoice_table (customer_invoices | mod_seminar_invoices), invoice_id. Optional: level (1|2), dry_run=true to see subject, text, recipient and new payment deadline without sending. Uses the tenant's templates (get_dunning_levels).

dry_run.description: Only simulate and report what would happen; change nothing

level.description: Dunning level to send (1 or 2); default the next level

name: send_dunning
